q: Never allow a person to tell you no who doesn't have the power to say yes.
Each day your life grows a day shorter. Make every move count.
Knowing is not enough, we must apply. Willing is not enough, we must do.
To think is easy. To act is hard. But the hardest thing in the world is to act in accordance with your thinking.
A bird does not sing because it has an answer. It sings because it has a song.
Why live an ordinary life, when you can live an extraordinary one.
Don't allow your mind to tell your heart what to do. The mind gives up easily.
Better to die fighting for freedom than be a prisoner all the days of your life.
You make your own luck if you stay at it long enough.
The ability to hold two competing thoughts in one's mind and still be able to function is the mark of a superior mind.
All life is an experiment. The more experiments you make, the better.
You may be disappointed if you fail, but you are doomed if you don't try.
You never know when a moment and a few sincere words can have an impact on a life.
Thinking will not overcome fear but action will.
Always focus on the front windshield and not the rear view mirror.
Obstacles don't block the path, they are the path.
Life reflects your own thoughts back to you.
A fall into a ditch makes you wiser.
An inch of time is an inch of gold but you can't buy that inch of time with an inch of gold.
It is not titles that honour men, but men that honour titles.
There are no shortcuts to any place worth going.
The season of failure is the best time for sowing the seeds of success.
Your visions will become clear only when you can look into your own heart. Who looks outside, dreams; who looks inside, awakes.
Adults are just children who earn money.
Love the life you live, live the life you love.
Success is the sum of small efforts, repeated day in and day out.
Think of yourself as dead. you have lived your life. Now, take what's left, and live it properly.
Unlike the stomach, the brain doesn't alert you when it's empty.

It is your attitude, not your aptitude, that determines your altitude.
To find yourself, think for yourself.
Most of the evil in this world is done by people with good intentions.
The birth of the mind is the death of the senses.
Being in a good frame of mind helps keep one in the picture of health.
Riches don't make a man rich, they only make him busier.
Behind every cloud is another cloud.
Our thoughts are highly influenced by the people around us and everything we read, see, and do.
He who loses wealth loses much; he who loses a friend loses more; but he that loses his courage loses all.
It's okay to be discouraged. It's not okay to quit.
Human beings believe just as they breathe - in order to survive.
Change is never easy, but always possible.
Make peace with your inner turmoil.
Short cuts make long delays.
People acting together as a group can accomplish things which no individual acting alone could ever hope to bring about.
A person who does not read is no better than one cannot read.
Many have died; you also will die. The drum of death is being beaten. The world has fallen in love with a dream. Only sayings of the wise will remain.
Why do you stay in prison when the door is so wide open?
Time you enjoy wasting, was not wasted.
First learn the meaning of what you say, and then speak.
Work out your own salvation. Do not depend on others.
